math_special_values.pow_floating: C99 exceptions: pow(NaN,0)=1, pow(1,NaN)=1 and pow(-1,+/-infinity)=1; otherwise NaN inputs propagate; signed-zero poles follow exponent sign/parity

math_special_values.fmod: truncated-quotient remainder, sign of numerator; zero divisor or infinite numerator -> NaN
math_special_values.remainder: nearest-integer quotient, ties-even; zero result sign of numerator; zero divisor or infinite numerator -> NaN
math_special_values.nextafter: next representable value toward second operand; equal operands return second (including sign of zero); any NaN -> NaN
math_special_values.hypot: nonnegative Euclidean norm; infinity dominates NaN as specified by C99 hypot
math_special_values.fdim: positive difference or +0; any NaN -> NaN
math_special_values.logaddexp: stable log(exp(x)+exp(y)); any NaN -> NaN; equal signed infinities retain that infinity
math_special_values.sign: finite nonzero -> signed one; retain signed zero or NaN; infinities -> signed one
math_special_values.fma: single-round x*y+z in promoted floating type; C99 invalid combinations -> NaN
